exposure: Multifaceted intervention designed to reduce cesarean delivery rates
multidisciplinary teams implemented multiple strategies supported by mentorship, shared learning, and rapid-cycle data feedback
Hospitals participating in quality improvement collaborative
baseline rates of cesarean delivery greater than 23.9% for NTSV births
multifaceted intervention designed to reduce the rates of cesarean delivery
outcome: Cesarean delivery rates for nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex (NTSV) births
cohort: 7,574,889 NTSV births in the US and at 238 nonmilitary hospitals providing maternity services in California
finding: A multifaceted intervention, including a quality improvement collaborative and statewide initiatives, was associated with a decrease in cesarean delivery rates for NTSV births in California.
mod_finding: This study examined cesarean delivery rates and did not report on specific modes of delivery.
